subject: Life Skills
title: Digital Boundaries
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Digital Boundaries.

hook.text: Her ex kept texting from new numbers. She blocked each one. He made another. The cycle drained her for months.

buildup.text: Digital boundaries are harder to enforce because access is cheap. A new account costs nothing.

discovery.text: Document every attempt. Screenshots with dates are evidence.

twist.text: Do not respond, even to say 'stop.' Any reply — even anger — rewards the behavior and restarts the cycle.

climax.text: Report to the platform, keep records, and consult local resources if it escalates. You do not have to handle this alone.

punchline.text: Document, report, do not respond. Silence is power.

quiz.question: Why should you never reply to a persistent harasser online?
options: Any response rewards the behavior and restarts the cycle
Platforms cannot help if you have replied
